Based on the latest Claude Code release notes, here are the most recent updates:

## Latest Claude Code Release (v2.1.288)

Claude Code recently released a broad reliability and UX update with smarter resume and recovery flows, stronger plugin and MCP handling, improved permission and auto mode behavior, and many fixes for cloud, SDK, screen reader, and terminal sessions.

## Key Recent Features

Claude introduced mods for Claude Code, letting users add TypeScript-based custom behavior, new UI, and feature replacements in the CLI and desktop app. Mods ship in plugins, can be shared through the directory, and give teams more control over how Claude Code works.

Claude also introduced a new beta experience for Claude Code projects, letting one project coordinate parallel threads, shared memory, and a project library to manage long-running work across repos and tasks. Now in a Claude Code project, you describe what needs to get done and Claude manages the work.

## Other Recent Updates

Recent releases have included improvements such as iOS Simulator support, allowing Claude Code to build your iOS app, launch the simulator, and verify the result without leaving the session. Additionally, the transcript now masks API keys and tokens by default; you can click the eye icon to reveal them.
